remarks: Luxury New Construction in the Heart of New Canaan! Coming Soon 2026!   Experience the finest in modern living with this exceptional new home by Kaeser Custom Homes, renowned for quality craftsmanship and timeless design. Ideally situated between South Ave and South School, this elegant residence offers the perfect blend of neighborhood, convenience, and luxury-with sidewalk access to town for ultimate enjoyment.   Spanning over 6,200 square feet across four beautifully finished levels, this 5 ensuite bedroom, 6 full and 2 half-bath masterpiece is thoughtfully designed for both everyday living and stylish entertaining.   Highlights include:  Gourmet chef's kitchen with top-tier appliances opens to a spacious family room with a fireplace.  Luxurious primary suite with personal sitting room, spa-like bath and walk-in closet. Private home office, formal dining, and flexible living spaces. Finished lower level ideal for a gym and media room.   Set on a picturesque lot with professionally landscaped grounds, this home is a rare opportunity to own a newly built property in one of New Canaan's in-town neighborhoods.
